text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp had begun.
And there before us—stood an unfamiliar lineup of faces.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It has been so long since we trained together.
I have been looking forward to this so much.
I'm simply glad to be able to do something for the Rose Clan again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Normally, once you retire, you don't get the chance
to be this involved anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
In that sense as well,
being born into the House of the Rose was truly lucky.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If there is still anything we can do,
allow us to pursue peace for the Rose Clan alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting the day after rushing into the main estate,
events began moving at a dizzying pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The training staff, along with every member of the Rose Clan who had racing experience, banded together to support Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words—the full might of the Rose Clan
was to be brought to bear.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer informed me that you have agreed to assist me,
so that I may elevate my abilities further
and achieve the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply grateful for your assistance.
I look forward to working with you.
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, pleasantries aside.
The amount of training I have in mind
is by no means for the faint of heart.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Staking the prestige of our clan, we shall seize the crown.
—Toward a future where the red rose blooms!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed.
Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms.
